description: A self-authored internal note recorded by the atperson entity: a reflection, a consolidation summary, or a movement trigger notice. The record object mirrors the entity's durable thought store so the locally stored record can be published in full to the entity's PDS — no digest-and-refetch reconstruction is needed. Record key is the TID frozen at creation; lexicographic order is creation order.

kind.description: The thought's role: 'reflection' is a hand-recorded note, 'consolidation' a scheduled reflection-pass summary, 'movement' a threshold trigger notice. knownValues is open so future kinds can be added without a breaking change.

text.description: The entity's own words. Deliberately only self-authored text.

about.description: The record this thought concerns, as an at-URI, or null when the thought references no other record.

at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the thought was created.

span_start.description: Start of the analysis window a pass-generated thought summarises. Present only on pass provenance; omitted for hand-recorded thoughts.

span_end.description: End of the analysis window a pass-generated thought summarises. Present only on pass provenance; omitted for hand-recorded thoughts.

topic.description: The dedup subject key the reflection pass uses so a rerun over the same window never emits a duplicate trigger.
